task.description:
Produce design artefacts for ENV-01, ENV-02, ENV-03, ENV-05 (Stage 14 test-tenant environment batch 1).

Read requirements: docs/requirements/ENV-01.md, docs/requirements/ENV-02.md, docs/requirements/ENV-03.md, docs/requirements/ENV-05.md

Classify and produce:
- ENV-01: DB migration (Type C) — new columns on public.tenant, constraint logic, updated onboarding
- ENV-02: No new code beyond policy documentation; verified by ENV-01 isolation tests
- ENV-03: Type E prose design — POST /api/v1/tenants/:test_tenant_id/promote/:definition_name
- ENV-05: Type E prose design — POST /api/v1/admin/tenants/:id/reset + DELETE /api/v1/admin/tenants/:id

Deliver:
- templates/specs/env-01.migration.yaml (Type C)
- src/design/tenant-env.md (Type E for ENV-02, ENV-03, ENV-05)

REWORK 1 — Fix issues from CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR:
[MAJOR] src/design/tenant-env.md E010 — Missing Module Purpose section. Lint requires a top-level purpose paragraph before any subsections.
[MAJOR] src/design/tenant-env.md E010 — Missing Error Taxonomy section. OnboardingError, PromotionError, TenantLifecycleError are defined inline; need consolidated top-level error section.
[MAJOR] env-01.migration.yaml codegen preview omits both CHECK constraints (tenant_type IN and ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence). Must ensure codegen output or CUSTOM: block covers these.
[MINOR] src/design/tenant-env.md E030 — 27 occurrences of schema-qualified names (public.tenant etc). Use unqualified names throughout.
[MINOR] src/design/tenant-env.md §1.1 — TenantType.fromString and TenantType.asString method bodies present. Type E must show interfaces only, no function bodies.

result.summary: REWORK 1 complete: added Module Purpose and Error Taxonomy sections, removed method bodies, fixed 27 schema-qualified names, extended codegen to emit CHECK constraints in ALTER TABLE mode. Both lint checks pass; codegen dry-run shows both CHECK constraints.
